system.description:
Will Amp

When you would act as a Herald, by spending 2 Focus, you instead become a Typhoon. You gain the benefits of being a Herald, you gain 1 Pressure at the end of each of your turns and you may use the base effects of Gale Burst, Sharpening or Dragwind once per turn at no Pressure cost.

While a Typhoon, hostile creatures gain a +2 bonus to their attack rolls and +1 critical threat range when attacking you.
system.summary: Herald, plus 1 Pressure at the end of each turn and a free Gale Burst, Sharpening or Dragwind once per turn; hostiles get +2 to attack you and +1 critical range.

rules.text: Herald's benefits; +1 Pressure at the end of each turn; attacks against you +2 and +1 critical range (on this effect). Once per turn one base Gale Burst, Sharpening or Dragwind at no Pressure cost. Also spend 1 Pressure.
rules.label: Chakra Surge: Crash (Typhoon)

rules.text: Once per casting, Ninjutsu you cast deal +2d10 damage (half the dice for an area). This is added automatically when you cast.
You can use two or more Moldings on one casting; you can use the Draw Reserves skill action as an Action.
